correctness.rationale: The weighted sample has expected occupancy at least alpha m in each square annulus of thickness m. Chernoff plus Borel--Cantelli gives simultaneous eventual occupancy for all m between eta n and n. Every deleted annular point can be injectively charged to a bad quadruple inside the enclosing dyadic box, whose three published class bounds total at most 6 C alpha^4 2^T. Choosing alpha^3 <= eta/(192 C) leaves at least 3 alpha m/8 points.

originality.rationale: The motivating preprint proves linear prefix density and uses dyadic shells only to control its deletion estimates. Targeted searches of no-four-on-a-circle and extensible constructions with annular, shell, dyadic-shell, and local-density formulations found no simultaneous thick-annulus lower bound. The earlier finite-box paper does not supply this extensible annular statement.

value.rationale: The theorem upgrades global prefix density to uniform mesoscopic radial regularity on every constant-relative-thickness square shell and isolates a reusable concentration-plus-deletion mechanism for extensible geometric avoidance constructions.
